scope_rule: Alternate Russian PKI acceptance requires an enabled policy, a present non-default dedicated userContextId, and the real channel OriginAttributes.mUserContextId to equal the current dedicated id before and after alternate verification.
disable_and_recreation_rule: Disabled, missing, deleted, recreated, stale, ordinary, and other-container contexts retain the standard error and GoodBearTrustDomain::Invalid; they never gain ordinary trust.
standard_first_rule: A successful standard verification returns Standard before consulting scope or alternate trust.
follow_up_boundary: GB100-M4-04 owns the complete alternate X.509 validator behind the exact-anchor callback; M4-03 neither recreates nor bypasses it.
